risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full package contents laid out (body + lens if included).

risks.risk: Functionality unknown (shutter, autofocus, buttons, ports, rear LCD brightness).

risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified (assume typical used risk; treat as worst case for functionality).

risks.proof: Photo of a test shot at high f-stop (e.g., f/16) showing dust on a plain surface, plus a close-up of the sensor area if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may need cleaning/has dust risk.

risks.risk: Battery/charger authenticity and health unknown (claim says original battery, but not shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the battery label/model and charger, and a clip showing battery installed and camera charging/working.

risks.risk: Shutter count/age unknown; D610 value depends heavily on usage.
risks.proof: Photo of EXIF/shutter count screen (or a screenshot from a shutter-count app) if available.

proof_requests: Clear photo of everything included (battery, charger, any cables, and whether a lens is included).
Video clip: power on, navigate menu, autofocus test, and take a short burst.
Test image photo showing sensor dust (shoot a plain bright surface at high f-stop).
Photo of battery label/model and charger label; show battery installed and camera working.
response.reason: The photos identify a Nikon D610 body, but key value drivers (lens included, accessories, and confirmed working condition/sensor health) are not verifiable from the provided images, so a safe price cannot be set from the comparables.
